events.event: Polri's ethics panel (KKEP) of five three-star generals led by Komjen Hendro Pandowo is set to hear ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo at 09.00 WIB on Thursday 26 November over the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo.
events.key_numbers: 26 Nov 09.00 WIB · 5 panel members (all Komjen) · panel chair Komjen Hendro Pandowo · 4 officers already dismissed (Ahrie Sonta, Eko Hadi Santoso, Tedjo Kusumo, AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra)
events.why_it_matters: The first ethics hearing of a former national police chief; the outcome (possible dismissal) shows how far Polri's internal clean-up goes.
events.spreading_evidence: Top item in detik index 25 Nov; multiple outlets covering the schedule

events.event: Bareskrim named a civilian identified only as NE a suspect in the illegal wiretapping case, alleging NE carried out orders from ex-Dirkrimum Polda Metro Jaya Kombes Iman Imanuddin to create hoaxes from a 'posko makar' in Cibinong, Bogor.
events.key_numbers: Wiretapping case: 5 suspects (Listyo Sigit, Slamet Uliandi, Eko Hadi Santoso, Ahrie Sonta Nasution, NE) · makar case: 6 suspects (adds Iman Imanuddin, Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo) · max penalty 20 years or death
events.why_it_matters: The case now reaches beyond the police into a civilian, raising the question of who else was behind the alleged plot.

events.event: After Prabowo nominated Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono to replace VP Gibran, parties split in their reactions: Demokrat supports, Golkar calls both worthy, PKB and PDIP hold back or question the picks, and DPD says it will consult Prabowo before the vote.
events.key_numbers: 2 candidates (Amran Sulaiman, Sugiono) · letter delivered 23 Nov before 23.59 deadline · MPR vote about 2 weeks away (plenary set 9 Dec) · DPD 18 members on ad hoc committee/verification team
events.why_it_matters: Whether the MPR votes by ballot or consensus decides who becomes Indonesia's next vice president.
events.spreading_evidence: Three of the top ten items in detik index 25 Nov concern the nominations

events.event: President Prabowo met DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad one-on-one at the Palace for about two hours, with the Setkab saying Dasco passed on public aspirations and reports received by the DPR.
events.key_numbers: ~2 hours · 24 Nov afternoon · same day Prabowo ordered quick follow-up of ~USD 15 billion Shenzhen investment deals
events.why_it_matters: Dasco was floated as a possible VP pick, so closed-door meetings with Prabowo are read as signals about the succession.

events.event: Polri and Philippine police named 139 Indonesians suspects in an online scam run from KE Towers in Pasay City, Manila, targeting victims in Indonesia; Komdigi minister Meutya Hafid and Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto spoke at Soekarno-Hatta airport.
events.key_numbers: 139 WNI suspects (one video headline says 141) · up to 15 years prison · charges: fraud, data manipulation, TPPU
events.why_it_matters: Scam syndicates use official uniforms and state symbols to trick Indonesians out of money.
events.spreading_evidence: Two items in detik index top ten, 24-25 Nov

events.event: KPK seized apartment-rental income owned by a suspect in the Papua Provincial Government operational-funds corruption case, which KPK puts at Rp1.2 trillion in state loss, while pursuing sub-treasurer Deus Enumbi.
events.key_numbers: Rp1.2 trillion state loss · ~Rp1 trillion annual allocation under a governor's regulation · amount seized not disclosed · Lukas Enembe died 26 Dec 2023
events.why_it_matters: Shows how KPK tries to claw back assets from a regional budget scheme worth about a trillion rupiah a year.

events.event: Depok immigration refused a passport to a man identified as DA after finding Telegram chats about joining Russia as a mercenary; he said he saw the recruitment ad on TikTok and cited economic hardship, and Polda Metro Jaya is investigating other parties.
events.key_numbers: Claimed offer: USD 50,000 signing · USD 3,000-6,000 monthly · USD 167,000 to family if killed · USD 100 per recruit · applied 18 Nov, questioned 23 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows how TikTok ads and big dollar promises lure ordinary Indonesians toward a foreign war.
